receipt.public_excerpt: no Chinese model has yet surpassed the ECI of OpenAI’s o3 model, released in April 2025.

evidence_items.explanation: As of January 2026 no Chinese model had passed an April 2025 US model on Epoch's index. Under Epoch's method that implies a gap of about eight months in December 2025, more than 'a few'. The same page gives a seven-month average and a four-month minimum since 2023.

receipt.public_excerpt: Moonshot AI's Kimi K2 Thinking achieves a 67 in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. This positions it clearly above all other open weights models, including the recently released MiniMax-M2 and DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and second only to GPT-5 amongst proprietary models.

evidence_items.explanation: In November 2025 the top Chinese model trailed only GPT-5, released August 7, 2025 (e3), on this index. That is a gap of about three months, which fits 'a few months'.

receipt.public_excerpt: We are introducing GPT‑5, our best AI system yet.

evidence_items.explanation: Gives GPT-5's release date, which is needed to turn the Artificial Analysis ranking (e2) into a lag in months.

evidence_items.publisher: NIST Center for AI Standards and Innovation

receipt.public_excerpt: Kimi K2 Thinking’s capabilities on agentic cyber and software engineering tasks remain below that of leading U.S. models, even older models such as GPT-5 and Opus 4.

evidence_items.explanation: The US government evaluator found the best Chinese model below older US models on agentic tasks, though its own table shows it ahead of GPT-5 on some math benchmarks. This points to a gap longer than a few months in some domains.

receipt.public_excerpt: "Maybe they're only a matter of months behind at this point," Hassabis told The Tech Download.

evidence_items.explanation: A leading US lab head gave a similar, hedged estimate a month after the post. It does not say whether the gap is at most a few months.

unresolved_gaps: Epoch did not publish a gap figure for December 2025 itself. The roughly eight-month figure is inferred from its statement about o3.
Artificial Analysis gave no month-based lag. The roughly three-month figure is inferred from the ranking and GPT-5's release date.
No single agreed measure of the lag exists.
